mapper.insert: INSERT INTO face_vectors (user_id, face_vector, face_image_url, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{faceVector, typeHandler=com.revy.talkblogback.handler.PgVectorTypeHandler}, #{faceImageUrl}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT vector_id, user_id, face_vector, face_image_url, created_at, updated_at FROM face_vectors ORDER BY face_vector <=> #{queryVector, typeHandler=com.revy.talkblogback.handler.PgVectorTypeHandler} LIMIT 1
